item.title: Book review: Ask your developer
item.description: Ask Your Developer: How to Harness the Power of Software Developers and Win in the 21st Century by Jeff Lawson was the book that influenced me the most last year. It is about how to run a software development company and the main theme is what the title says, use your developers competence and problems solving competence. Give them problems that you want them to solve instead of detailed descriptions of what to do. This does not mean that everyone does whatever they want, the company needs to set the direction, the focus and the guardrails. My main takeaways:
